tasks.task_markdown: Establish the repository baseline before implementation. Read [[DEEPSEEK_ROUTING_AND_ENV_CONFIG_DESIGN.md]]. Inspect the current branch, HEAD, staged, unstaged, and untracked files. Commit existing work in the authorized scope: the DeepSeek routing/environment design and this implementation Kanban's durable planning files. Preserve and exclude unrelated user changes, generated execution/context/task files, caches, logs, secrets, and credentials. Do not push, amend, switch branches, or discard changes.
tasks.title: Commit the authorized baseline
tasks.verification: Record git status --short, git diff --stat, git diff --cached --stat, untracked files, branch, and before HEAD. If eligible changes exist, create a successful commit, then record after HEAD, git log -1, and git show --stat HEAD. If no eligible content exists, record the checks and 'Skipped: no changes to commit'; do not create an empty commit.

tasks.task_markdown: Implement the configuration contract from [[DEEPSEEK_ROUTING_AND_ENV_CONFIG_DESIGN.md]]: strict versioned JSON schema, config and environment selection, documented environment overrides, deterministic relative-path resolution, portable catalog defaults, and removal of the E:/workshop/copilot-api hardcode. Integrate config/env CLI arguments and split path preparation so Copilot credentials are not touched in DeepSeek-only mode. Preserve default Copilot-only behavior.
tasks.title: Implement runtime configuration and portable paths
tasks.verification: Add focused runtime configuration and path tests covering precedence, invalid values, missing environments, cwd independence, and portable defaults. Run the focused tests and typecheck relevant code.

tasks.task_markdown: Add request-local model routing, typed local errors, DeepSeek Responses transport with isolated bearer authentication, safe base URL handling, redirect prevention, AbortSignal propagation, upstream header/error forwarding, and no provider fallback. Route /responses by model while preserving Copilot aliases and provider-specific SSE normalization. Reject unsupported DeepSeek history and tools as designed.
tasks.title: Implement provider routing and DeepSeek Responses transport
tasks.verification: Add focused routing, transport, response endpoint, credential isolation, error, cancellation, and streaming tests. Confirm concurrent Copilot and DeepSeek requests cannot cross routes.

tasks.task_markdown: Make startup initialize only enabled providers, fail clearly on missing enabled-provider credentials, support Copilot-only/mixed/DeepSeek-only modes, merge DeepSeek into /models without requiring Copilot state, and reject DeepSeek models on unsupported endpoints and Copilot-only usage/token surfaces. Keep Claude Code selection restricted as designed.
tasks.title: Integrate provider initialization and model discovery
tasks.verification: Add startup and endpoint tests proving DeepSeek-only performs no GitHub/Copilot initialization and unsupported endpoint requests cannot fall into Copilot.

tasks.task_markdown: Refactor catalog generation to explicit inputs/outputs, add packaged DeepSeek model metadata with source notes, merge/filter enabled models deterministically, validate duplicate and missing metadata, cache the last successful upstream catalog separately, support first-start offline local generation, and preserve atomic output replacement. Ensure build and package contain the metadata resource.
tasks.title: Implement portable Codex model catalog generation
tasks.verification: Extend catalog tests for merge order, filtering, offline cache, first-start offline behavior, input failures, atomic preservation, and packaged resource availability. Build the package and inspect the output.

tasks.task_markdown: Add config.example.json and update README, start.bat, Dockerfile, and entrypoint.sh for Windows, Linux, and Docker configuration. Document same-profile model switching, host/container catalog paths, credential injection, migration from the old E drive hardcode, feature limits, and rollback. Do not include real secrets or user-specific committed paths.
tasks.title: Update deployment entrypoints and documentation
tasks.verification: Review examples for consistency with the implemented schema. Validate JSON and shell/batch argument behavior where automatable. Confirm no committed example contains a real credential or Jeff-specific path.

tasks.task_markdown: Run the full verification required by [[DEEPSEEK_ROUTING_AND_ENV_CONFIG_DESIGN.md]]: bun run typecheck, bun run lint, bun test, bun run build, plus focused integration checks possible without real credentials. Inspect the complete diff for regressions, security leaks, generated artifacts, stale hardcoded paths, and documentation drift. Fix all in-scope failures and record any credential-dependent live checks that cannot be run.
tasks.title: Validate the complete implementation
tasks.verification: All four project checks pass. Search confirms the old E:/workshop/copilot-api hardcode is absent from runtime code and no secret is committed. Record test counts/results and remaining live-only limitations.
